long_option_contract_selection.approval: ACK 18 Sep 2026: the horizon informs contract choice, it never gates it
long_option_contract_selection.value_selection_approval: ACK 18 Sep 2026: choose the contract by central return per dollar of premium; SHADOW until proven (rule 5), ACK switches to ACTIVE
long_option_contract_selection.rationale: One delta preference (the union of the former per-horizon ranges) and one spread limit (the reviewable ceiling) for every horizon. Runway is a floor: anticipated move + monitor + exit buffer sessions in calendar days; a contract short of it is flagged, a longer one is mildly penalised per extra day so the nearest covering expiry wins ties, never excluded. A missing horizon uses the full 20-session thesis window (ACK: buy more runway) and is reported. Evidence: 17 Sep evening run, 838 of 1,359 searches found no contract.

morning_runway.note: XLU-D11 (ACK 2 Oct 2026): a Morning move confirms (or pressures) the thesis only when it is at least this fraction of the one-session expected move. Engineering starting point recorded before evaluation; to be calibrated with the outcome scorer on recorded Morning moves.

trigger_vol_compression.note: XLU-D04 (ACK 2 Oct 2026, flag only): VOL_COMPRESSION's 'options cheap' premise is checked on ivp_label (implied vol vs the ticker's own history, owned by Options). option_walls.approved: ACK 10 Oct 2026: item 7 with ACK's call-wall review (Enhancements/phase7/ITEM7_WALLS_DESIGN_20261010.md)
option_walls.basis: INITIAL VALUES, to calibrate in item 10 (C-1) on recorded chains and price outcomes. longer cutoff = the 110-day chain the Options stage fetches; relevance = 2 x ATM IV x sqrt(sessions to the basket's last expiry / 252) around spot (replaces +/-30%); a zone qualifies at >= 10% of its side's basket dollar-gamma (SMCI 8 Oct: hold-basket zones 8-18%); neighbours join a zone at >= 50% of the peak; price response over 60 completed sessions with a 0.25 x ATR(14) touch tolerance; gamma flip below 0.3 confidence is LOW_CONFIDENCE (SMCI 8 Oct: 0.067).
option_walls.authority: DISPLAY_AND_CONTEXT_ONLY until ACK decides which readers may use a wall as a price level (design section 8)

station_inspection.approved: ACK 9-10 Oct 2026: output-trust item 10 (C-2) - integrity defects stop the line with the reason
station_inspection.basis: Each STOP check was zero on the healthy run 20261008_220129 (Discovery 2,933 -> Options 2,788 with all 145 losses recorded at CANONICAL_MANIFEST; EOD, book and Morning keep all 2,788; no duplicate, blank or invented tickers, side mismatches, crossed or negative quotes, non-positive prices, wrong-side levels or future timestamps). enforce=false makes every station report-only (a stated switch, for ACK).

forward_calibration.basis: ACK 9-10 Oct 2026 (item 10.2): a setup's stated rate is forward-calibrated only after 100 resolved outcomes over 20 distinct evidence sessions (20 = the C12 scorer's min_sessions_for_verdict; 100 gives a Wilson half-width of about +/-10 points near 50%). Until then UNCALIBRATED_FORWARD.
forward_calibration.window_basis: C12 scores a 20-session window (outcome.window_sessions; max sessions_observed in the store = 20). A setup hold longer than the window is BEYOND_SCORER_WINDOW on a window TIMEOUT, never a miss. Bars convert to sessions at 1 / 5 / 21 per 1d / 1w / 1mo bar (setup_rates_v1.json timeframes).
